This Policy Framework outlines the Occupational Health (OH) and Employee Assistance policy statement, describe the OH and Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) services available to our staff and define the responsibilities of MOJ and HMPPS key stakeholders.

The policy applies to all directly employed MOJ and HMPPS staff who hold an MOJ or HMPPS staff number and, in particular, line managers who will be required to manage and support the health and wellbeing of potential and existing employees fairly and effectively.
